# Lists

- Apples
- Oranges with `code` and a [link](https://wordpress.org/)
  - Nested one
  - Nested two
- Pears

An ordered list:

1. First
2. Second
   1. Nested ordered

A loose list (one paragraph per item) is still a list block:

- Loose item one

- Loose item two

Steps with code inside an item cannot be list blocks and become one HTML block:

1. Step with a code sample:

   ```bash
   npx wp-env start
   ```

2. Next step
